source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API + raw WZ API; class-specific 5th job skill list cross-checked against maplestorywiki.net
notes: 1st-job skills come from the job-4100 skillbook ([Shinsoku] Mist Slash, [Shinsoku] Grazing Cut, Battoujutsu Dash, Aoryu); the 4001 WZ file contains only beginner + shared skills.
5th-job V skills and Beginner skills are being fetched via the raw WZ API.

skills.description:
Your attacks grow sharper as you immerse yourself in the ways of the Akatsuki Style.
Enter Akatsuki state upon using a Battou skill. Akatsuki lasts to up to 60 seconds. Increases Final Damage and Ignore Defense while the state is active.
Right-click to lock activation effect.

skills.name: Noto
skills.description:
Sheathe your blade and catch your breath.
Temporarily gain Noto state. Using a Battou skill while in Noto cancels Noto and significantly enhances the Battou skill.
Not affected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: [Shinsoku] Afterimage Slash
skills.description:
Shinsoku Akatsuki Style Eighth Form.\r
Charge forward, slashing enemies in your path and leaving behind an Afterimage. Press the skill key again before the skill ends to return to your Afterimage, slashing enemies along the path and then unleashing an AoE attack.
You cannot perform this second attack if you are too far from your Afterimage.
If no direction is pressed, this skill will be used while standing still.

skills.name: Akatsuki Will
skills.description: Hone your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through.

skills.name: Akatsuki Warrior

skills.name: Shogetsu Form
skills.description:
Shogetsu Akatsuki Style Divine Technique.\r
Witness the new moon seen only by the masters of Akatsuki Style. Your swordsmanship illuminates the endless night.
Temporarily enter the Noto and Shogetsu states. While it lasts, Shogetsu replaces the Akatsuki state, increasing Final Damage and Ignore Defense while it lasts. Enhances all Battou skills, increasing attack activations. No enemy attack can knock you back.
